difference_definition: comparator minus TCN for RMSE/MAE; positive values favor TCN
features: Same 20 voltage/current within-cycle statistical features as the feature-matched clean benchmark.
initialization_policy: Three initialization seeds are averaged within each cell-level split; the five split seeds remain the higher-level repeated-holdout units.

multiple_testing.definition: Two primary comparators x four domains. Apply Holm adjustment separately to the eight RMSE p-values and eight MAE p-values.

paired_analysis: Average the three TCN initialization seeds within each split_seed and compare against the corresponding three-seed split-level means of each frozen comparator.

preprocessing.base_standardization: split-specific pooled supervised scaler fitted using training cells only
preprocessing.sequence_construction_order: Apply frozen train-only feature standardization to cycle observations, then construct the three-cycle causal window independently within each cell.

purpose: Provide an explicit causal sequence-model baseline to test whether temporal-sequence learning can explain performance otherwise attributed to causal graph message passing.
secondary_metric: R2 reported descriptively by physical dataset
sequence_boundary_rule: Unavailable historical positions at cell start are filled by replicating the first valid observation of that same cell.
signflip_interpretation: Repeated-split sensitivity analysis only; the five splits are not treated as five independent datasets.
signflip_test: Exact two-sided paired sign-flip sensitivity test over the five split-level differences.

test_blinding_record.interpretation: The TCN experiment is a pre-test-frozen sensitivity extension, not a prospectively blinded comparison against previously unseen reference results.

training.epoch_ceiling_rule: If any TCN fit reaches epoch 5000 without patience stopping, do not inspect TCN test metrics; revisit optimization budget using train/validation information only.

training_test_barrier.rule: All 15 TCN training/validation fits and an immutable training-closure artifact must be complete before the first TCN test tensor or test metric is evaluated.
